title: DON'T LET THE SUN RISE WITHOUT PRAYING THIS – PSALM 5 MORNING PRAYER
text: Glory, glory, glory to the most high God. Hallelujah. Somebody shout, "Jesus is Lord." Jesus is Lord. Oh, I feel the weight of glory in this place already. I feel the tangible presence of the Holy Spirit. Something is shifting in the atmosphere. Something is breaking in the realm of the spirit. And I want you to know wherever you are listening to this, you have not stumbled upon this message by accident. This is a divine appointment. This is a scheduled encounter. Heaven orchestrated this moment before the foundation of the world. And I want you to do something for me before we go any further. I want you to share this message. Send the link to someone. Post it on your status. Share it in your groups because the word you are about to receive is not just for you. It is for someone who is desperate. Someone who is at the end of their rope. someone who needs exactly what God is about to release through this ministry. You may be the bridge between their captivity and their freedom. You may be the instrument God uses to deliver a generation. So share this word. Let it go viral. Let it spread like fire. For the Bible says in Jeremiah 23:29, "Is not my word like as a fire, sayeth the Lord, and like a hammer that breakth the rock in pieces? This word is fire and fire spreads. This word is a hammer and hammers break things. Whatever has been resisting in your life, whatever has been standing against your destiny, the word of God is about to break it in pieces. Hallelujah. Now, I want us to enter into the presence of God through worship. But this is not ordinary worship. This is worship that shifts atmospheres. This is worship that opens heavens. This is worship that invites the manifest presence of the king. So wherever you are, I want you to lift your voice. Lift your hands if you can. Close your eyes if you need to, but engage. Enter in. Press into the presence of God. Father, we worship you. We worship you, Lord. You are holy. You are righteous. You are faithful. You are mighty. You are wonderful. You are beautiful. You are glorious. There is none like you in all the earth. There is none beside you in all the heavens. YOU STAND ALONE AS GOD. YOU REIGN supreme as king. And we bow before your majesty this morning. Hallelujah. Singing in the spirit. Shondor Rabbi Keha Robocai Shaba. Yes Lord. We worship you. We magnify your name. We exalt you above every name that is named, above every principality, above every power, above every might, above every dominion. You are seated far above all. And from that place of supreme authority, you look down upon the affairs of men. You see the end from the beginning. You know all things. You can do all things and nothing is impossible with you. We worship you. Hallelujah. You are the God who created the morning. You are the one who commands the dawn. You are the one who causes the sun to rise. You are the one who separates the light from the darkness. And we worship you. For the morning belongs to you. The day belongs to you. The night belongs to you. All of time belongs to you. And we worship you. Shondorba robo shaba. Father, we bless your name. We honor you. We adore you. We celebrate you. For you are worthy. Worthy of all praise. Worthy of all honor. Worthy of all glory. Worthy of all adoration. The four living creatures cry, "Holy, holy, holy, Lord God Almighty, which was and is and is to come." The 24 elders cast their crowns before your throne. The angels bow in reverent worship and we join the heavenly chorus. Holy, holy, holy is the Lord God Almighty. The whole earth is filled with your glory. Hallelujah. Let somebody worship him from the depths of your spirit. Let worship rise like incense before his throne. Let praise ascend like a sweet smelling savior. Father, we worship you. We worship you. We worship you. Kamehsa Robboi Shondori. Now I want to share something with you this morning that I believe will transform your life. And I need you to pay attention. Not casual attention, not divided attention, but focused, intentional, hungry attention. The title of this ministration is don't let the sun rise without praying. This Psalm 5 morning prayer. And I want to tell you something. This is not a suggestion. This is not a recommendation. This is a spiritual instruction. It is a prophetic mandate. It is a kingdom strategy that has the power to change the trajectory of your days, your weeks, your months, your years, your entire life. Don't let the sun rise without praying this. The implication is clear. There is something you must do before the sun rises. There is an engagement that must happen before daylight breaks. There is a spiritual transaction that must take place before the world wakes up. And if you miss it, you miss something critical. Let me take you to the scripture. Open your Bible to Psalm chapter 5 and let us read verses 1-3. The psalmist David writes, "Give ear to my words, O Lord. Consider my meditation. Hearken unto the voice of my cry, my king and my God. For unto thee will I pray. My voice shalt thou hear in the morning, O Lord. In the morning will I direct my prayer unto thee, and will look up. Did you catch that? My voice shalt thou hear in the morning, oh Lord. David made a covenant with God, a commitment, a decision. He said, "Lord, you will hear my voice in the morning, not in the afternoon when I've sorted out my schedule, not in the evening when I'm tired and exhausted in the morning before the day begins, before the demands come, before the distractions arise, you will hear my voice." And then he says something powerful. In the morning will I direct my prayer unto thee. The word direct is significant. In the Hebrew, it is the word arak. It means to set in order, to arrange, to prepare, to lay out systematically like a priest preparing a sacrifice on the altar, like a general arranging his troops for battle, like an architect laying the foundation of a structure. David is saying, "Lord, in the morning, I don't just mumble a few words. I don't just say a quick prayer out of religious obligation. I direct my prayer. I arrange it. I set it in order. I prepare it strategically. I lay it out before you with intentionality and precision. This is strategic prayer. This is military prayer. This is priestly prayer. This is kingdom prayer. Hallelujah. And then David says, "And will look up." The Hebrew word here is taffer. It means to watch, to observe, to be expectant, to act as a watchman on a tower looking for the approach of messengers or the movement of enemies. After David prays, he watches. He looks up. He's expectant. He knows that when he engages heaven in the morning, heaven responds and he positions himself to see what God will do. This is THE POSTURE OF FAITH. THIS IS THE ATTITUDE OF EXPECTATION. This is the disposition of a man who knows that prayer works. Hallelujah. Now, let me tell you why the morning is so important. And I need you to understand this revelation. In the beginning, when God created the heavens and the earth, he established a divine order. Genesis 1:5 says, "And God called the light day, and the darkness he called night, and the evening and the morning were the first day." The evening and the morning were the first day. God established that every day has a beginning. Every day has a starting point. Every day has a gate through which it enters. And the morning is that gate. The morning is the threshold of the day. The morning is the portal through which the day comes. And whoever controls the gate controls what enters. Let me say that again. Whoever controls the gate controls what enters. If you control the morning, you control the day. If you surrender the morning, you surrender the day. If you win the battle of the morning, you've already won the battle of the day. But if you lose the battle of the morning, you'll spend the rest of the day fighting battles you could have avoided. Hallelujah. This is why the enemy is strategic about the morning. He doesn't wait for you to wake up and engage heaven. No. While you're still sleeping, while you're hitting the snooze button, while you're scrolling through social media, while you're complaining about having to get up, the enemy is already at work. He's planting seeds of fear. He's planting seeds of anxiety. He's planting seeds of confusion. He's planting seeds of discouragement. He's planting seeds of failure. And by the time you realize what's happening, his seeds have already taken root. But I have good news for you today. The spirit of God is releasing a revelation that will equip you to beat the enemy at his own game. You will rise before he does. You will engage before he plans. You will speak before he whispers. You will decree before he suggests. Your morning is about to be transformed. Hallelujah. Let me give you another scripture. In Exodus 34:2, God speaks to Moses and says, "And be ready in the morning, and come up in the morning unto Mount Si, and present thyself there to me in the top of the mount." Be ready in the morning. God told Moses, "Come up in the morning. Present yourself in the morning." Why the morning? Because God had something to give Moses. God had tablets of stone with his law written on them. God had revelation to impart. God had instructions to release. God had a covenant to establish. And God scheduled that encounter for the morning. Not the afternoon, not the evening, the morning. Because the morning is the time of divine encounter. The morning is the hour of heavenly downloads. The morning is the moment when God speaks to those who are positioned to hear. Hallelujah. Let me show you something else. In Mark 1:35, the Bible records something about Jesus that is profoundly instructive. And in the morning, rising up a great while before day, he went out and departed into a solitary place and there prayed. This is Jesus Christ, the son of God, the second person of the Trinity, the one who spoke the world into existence, the one who commands angels, the one who has all authority in heaven and on earth. And yet he rose up a great while before day. He went to a solitary place and he prayed. If Jesus needed to pray in the morning, how much more do you and I? If Jesus prioritized the early hours, how much more should we? If Jesus understood the strategic importance of engaging heaven before the day began, how much more must we understand it? Hallelujah. Let me tell you what happens when you pray in the morning. Number one, you establish divine order over your day. When you pray in the morning, you're not just speaking words. You're establishing order. You're setting the agenda. You're determining the outcomes. You're declaring what will happen and what will not happen. Psalm 94:12 in the amplified version says, "My voice shalt thou hear in the morning, oh Lord. In the morning will I order my prayer unto thee and will look up. You order your prayer. You establish structure. You create a framework for your day based on the will and word of God. Number two, you activate angelic assistance. The Bible says in Hebrews 1:14, "Are they not all ministering spirits sent forth to minister for them who shall be heirs of salvation?" Angels are ministering spirits. They are sent to minister for the heirs of salvation. But angels respond to the word of God. Psalm 103:20 says, "Bless the Lord, ye his angels that excel in strength, that do his commandments, hearkening unto the voice of his word." Angels hearken unto the voice of God's word. When you pray the word of God in the morning, you're releasing sounds that angels respond to. You're giving them assignments. You're activating their ministry on your behalf. Number three, you cancel the enemy's agenda. The enemy has plans for your day. The Bible says in John 10:10, "The thief cometh not, but for to steal and to kill and to destroy." The enemy's agenda is to steal from you, to kill your dreams, to destroy your destiny. And he has specific strategies planned for your day. But when you pray in the morning, you cancel those strategies. You nullify his plans, you render his schemes ineffective. Isaiah 54:1 17 says, "No weapon that is formed against thee shall prosper, and every tongue that shall rise against thee in judgment, thou shalt condemn." Every weapon is formed. The enemy has weapons, but they shall not prosper when you engage in morning prayer. Number four, you access divine direction. Proverbs 3:es 5 and 6 say, "Trust in the Lord with all thine heart and lean not onto thine own understanding. In all thy ways acknowledge him, and he shall direct thy paths." When you acknowledge God in the morning, he directs your paths. He shows you which way to go. He reveals which doors to enter and which doors to avoid. He gives you wisdom for decisions. He grants you discernment for situations. You don't stumble through your day in confusion when you've prayed in the morning. You walk with clarity. You move with purpose. You proceed with confidence. Number five, you secure divine protection. Psalm 91:es 1-2 say, "He that dwelleth in the secret place of the most high shall abide under the shadow of the almighty. I will say of the Lord, he is my refuge and my fortress, my God. In him will I trust. When you dwell in the secret place through morning prayer, you position yourself under the shadow of the Almighty. You are covered. You are protected. You are shielded. The enemy cannot touch you because you are hidden in God. Hallelujah. Now, let me go deeper into Psalm 5 because this psalm contains prophetic keys that will transform your morning prayer. Look at verse one again. David says, "Give ear to my words, oh Lord. Consider my meditation." David is asking God to do two things. First, to give ear to his words. Second, to consider his meditation. This tells us that morning prayer involves both words and meditation. It's not just about speaking. It's about thinking. It's about pondering. It's about meditating on God's word and God's ways. When you wake up in the morning, your mind needs to be filled with God's word. Not with yesterday's problems, not with today's worries, not with tomorrow's fears, but with the eternal truth of God's word. Joshua 1:8 says, "This book of the law shall not depart out of thy mouth, but thou shalt meditate therein day and night, that thou mayest observe to do according to all that is written therein. For then thou shalt make thy way prosperous, and then thou shalt have good success." Meditation on God's word is connected to prosperity and success. When your mind is filled with God's word in the morning, you set yourself up for a prosperous and successful day. Hallelujah. Look at verse two. David says, "Hearken unto the voice of my cry, my king and my God. For unto thee will I pray." David addresses God as my king and my God. This is important. Before David asks for anything, he establishes relationship. He acknowledges who God is to him. God is his king. Meaning God has authority over his life. God is his God. Meaning David belongs to God. When you pray in the morning, you must start by establishing relationship. Not as a stranger coming to a distant diety but as a child coming to a loving father. As a subject coming to a benevolent king, as a servant coming to a gracious master. Your morning prayer should begin with acknowledgment of who God is and who you are in relation to him. Hallelujah. Look at verses 4 and 5. David says, "For thou art not a God that had pleasure in wickedness, neither shall evil dwell with thee. The foolish shall not stand in thy sight. Thou hatest all workers of iniquity." David is declaring God's character. He's affirming God's holiness. He's establishing that God is opposed to wickedness, evil, foolishness, and iniquity. When you pray in the morning, declare God's character over your day. Declare that because God is holy, no unholy thing shall attach itself to you. Declare that because God hates wickedness, wickedness shall be far from you. Declare that because God opposes evil, evil shall not prosper against you, your declarations about who God is become the foundation for your expectations of what God will do. Hallelujah. Look at verse 7. David says, "But as for me, I will come into thy house in the multitude of thy mercy, and in thy fear will I worship toward thy holy temple." David contrasts himself with the wicked. It says, "But as for me," this is a declaration of positioning. David is saying, "I'm not like them. I'm different. I'm set apart. I have access." And on what basis does David have access? the multitude of God's mercy. Not his own righteousness, not his own goodness, not his own merit, but God's mercy. When you pray in the morning, you come on the basis of mercy. You don't come because you deserve to come. You come because God is merciful. You come because the blood of Jesus has opened the way. You come because grace has made access possible. This should give you boldness. You don't have to feel worthy to pray. You don't have to feel qualified to approach God. The blood of Jesus qualifies you. Grace makes you worthy. Mercy opens the door. Come boldly to the throne of grace in the morning. Hallelujah. Look at verses 8-9. David prays, "Lead me, oh Lord, in thy righteousness because of mine enemies. Make thy way straight before my face, for there is no faithfulness in their mouth. Their inward part is very wickedness. Their throat is an open separ. They flatter with their tongue. David is asking for divine leading. He's asking God to make his way straight before his face. And he gives the reason because of his enemies. David understood that he had enemies. He understood that there were people whose mouths contained no faithfulness, people whose hearts were full of wickedness, people whose tongues were instruments of flattery and deception. And David's response was not to worry, not to fear, not to scheme his own escape. His response was to pray. Lead me, oh Lord. Make your way straight before me. When you pray in the morning, ask God for leading. Because you have enemies you know about and enemies you don't know about. You have adversaries you can see and adversaries operating in the shadows. You have people who smile to your face and plot against you behind your back. But when God leads you, you navigate safely through enemy territory. When God makes his way straight before you, you avoid the traps that have been set. When God directs your steps, you walk in victory, even when surrounded by opposition. Hallelujah. Look at verses 11 and 12. David concludes, "But let all those that put their trust in thee rejoice. Let them ever shout for joy because thou defendest them. Let them also that love thy name be joyful in thee. For thou Lord will bless the righteous. With favor will thou compass him as with a shield. This is the conclusion of the psalm. This is the promise. This is the reward for those who pray in the morning. Rejoicing, joy, defense, blessing, favor. God defends those who trust him. God causes those who love him to be joyful. God blesses the righteous and God surrounds them with favor as with a shield. A shield of favor. Favor that protects you. Favor that surrounds you. Favor that goes before you and comes behind you. Favor that opens doors. Favor that attracts opportunities. Favor that shifts situations in your direction. When you pray Psalm 5 in the morning, you activate the shield of favor. Hallelujah. I want to prophesy to someone right now. The Lord is showing me that there is someone listening who has been living without this shield. You've been exposed, vulnerable, unprotected, and the enemy has been taking shots at you. Attacks have been landing. Arrows have been hitting their marks. And you've wondered why you can't seem to escape the onslaught. But I prophesy to you today, the shield is being restored. The favor is returning. From this day forward, as you engage in morning prayer, the shield of favor shall compass you about. What was hitting you shall now bounce off. What was penetrating shall now be deflected. You are covered. You are protected. You are shielded. Receive it now. Shondorabi keia roboi. Hallelujah. Now I want to shift into prayer and I need everyone to stand to their feet wherever you are. We're going to pray Psalm 5 over our lives. We're going to pray it over our mornings. We're going to pray it over our days. We're going to pray it over our families. We're going to pray it over our destinies. And this is not casual prayer. This is warfare prayer. This is prophetic prayer. This is kingdom prayer. SO ENGAGE, PRESS IN, CONTEND shondokai shaba. Yes Lord, father in the name of Jesus, I come before your throne this morning. I come with boldness. I come with confidence. I come with authority for I have access through the blood of your son. I have a right to approach you through the new and living way. And I say as David said, give ear to my words, oh Lord. Consider my meditation. Lord, hear my words. Not just the words of my mouth, but the words of my heart. Not just what I speak audibly, but what I groan inwardly. Hear me, Lord. Listen to me. Attend to my prayer. I cry unto you, my king and my God, for you are my king. You have authority over my life. Your word is law in my existence. Your will is supreme in my affairs. I submit to your kingship. I bow to your lordship. I surrender to your sovereignty. And you are my God. I belong to you. I am yours by creation and yours by redemption. You made me and you bought me. I am doubly yours and I worship you. Hallelujah. Now I declare as David declared, "My voice shalt thou hear in the morning, oh Lord. In the morning will I direct my prayer unto thee and will look up. I make a covenant right now. From this day forward, my mornings belong to God. Before the sun rises, my voice shall rise. Before the day begins, my prayer shall begin. Before the demands come, my devotion shall come. I will not let the sun rise without praying. I will not let the day start without engaging heaven. I will not let the enemy have the first word over my life. My voice shall be heard in the morning. Shondai kameha. Father, I thank you that you are not a God that has pleasure in wickedness. Evil does not dwell with you. The foolish cannot stand in your sight. You hate all workers of iniquity. And because of who you are, I declare over my morning and over my day, wickedness shall not prosper against me. Evil shall not dwell in my house. Foolishness shall not characterize my decisions. I am separated from the workers of iniquity. The plans of the wicked against me shall fail. The schemes of the enemy against me shall crumble. The conspiracies of darkness against me shall be exposed and destroyed. Because my God is holy. I am protected. Because my God hates wickedness. Wickedness cannot prevail against me. Hallelujah. I come into your house, Lord, in the multitude of your mercy, not in my own righteousness, but in your mercy. Not in my own goodness, but in your grace. Not in my own worthiness, but in the blood of Jesus. The blood speaks for me. The blood opens doors for me. The blood gives me access. The blood makes me accepted. I am accepted in the beloved. And in your fear I worship toward your holy temple Robboi Shondorabai Shaba. Now Lord lead me in your righteousness because of my enemies. I acknowledge that I have enemies not just flesh and blood but principalities and powers and rulers of darkness and spiritual wickedness in high places. I have enemies I know about and enemies I don't know about. I have adversaries who have made themselves known and adversaries operating in secret. But I ask you to lead me. Lead me past the traps they have set. Lead me around the snares they have laid. Lead me over the obstacles they have placed. Lead me through the valleys they hoped would destroy me. Make your way straight before my face. Let me not walk in confusion. Let me not stumble in darkness. Let me not wander in uncertainty. Make your path clear. Make your direction plain. Make your will known. I shall not be deceived. I shall not be misled. I shall not be confused. Shondor rabbi Kameha Robboi. Father I declare over my enemies what David declared. There is no faithfulness in their mouth. Their inward part is very wickedness. Their throat is an open separ. They flatter with their tongue. But I am not moved by their flattery. I am not deceived by their smooth words. I am not tricked by their pretenses. I discern their true intentions. I perceive their hidden agendas. I see through their masks. And I pray as David prayed, "Destroy their counsel, oh God. Let them fall by their own schemes. Cast them out in the multitude of their transgressions. for they have rebelled against you. Every council of the enemy against my life is destroyed now. Every strategy of darkness against my destiny falls now. Every scheme of the wicked against my family crumbles now. By their own devices they shall fall. By their own traps they shall be caught. By their own pits they shall be swallowed. Hallelujah. Now I declare what David declared. Let all those that put their trust in you rejoice. LET THEM EVER SHOUT for joy because you defend them. Let them that love your name be joyful in you. I put my trust in you, Lord, and I will rejoice. Not because my circumstances are perfect. Not because my problems are solved, not because my challenges are removed, but because you are faithful. Because you defend me. Because you fight for me. Because you are on my side, I will rejoice. I will shout for joy. I will be joyful in you. Shondor rabbi keia. And Lord, I receive the promise. You will bless the righteous with favor. You will compass them as with a shield. I receive the blessing of the righteous. I am righteous not by my own works, but by the blood of Jesus. I have been made the righteousness of God in Christ. And because I am righteous, I am blessed. Blessing on my head, blessing on my hands, blessing on my feet, blessing on my family, blessing on my finances, blessing on my health, blessing on my relationships, blessing on my ministry, blessing on my business, blessing on everything that concerns me. Hallelujah. And I receive the shield of favor. Favor surrounds me as a shield. Favor goes before me and prepares my way. Favor comes behind me and protects my back. Favor stands at my right hand and my left. Favor is above me and below me. I am enclosed in favor. I am wrapped in favor. I am covered in favor. Favor in the marketplace. Favor in the workplace. Favor in the government. Favor in the church. Favor with God and favor with men. Favor that opens doors no man can shut. Favor that shifts situations in my direction. Favor that attracts blessings and opportunities. Favor that commands attention and respect. Favor that releases resources and assistance. The shield of favor is upon me. Robocali shondor keaba. Yes, Lord. Fire. Fire. Fire. The Lord is showing me someone. You've been waiting for a breakthrough that seemed impossible. This week, the impossible becomes possible. What man said cannot happen, God is making happen. Receive it now. There's someone else. You've been under financial pressure that seemed unending. I see relief coming. I see doors opening. I see resources flowing. Before this month ends, your testimony shall be loud. Shondor Rabbi Kameha Robboi. Now I seal this prayer. I seal every declaration with the blood of Jesus. I seal every decree with the fire of the Holy Ghost. I seal every word with the authority of heaven. What has been spoken shall not fall to the ground. What has been released shall not return void. What has been declared shall be established. The siege is over. The battle is won. The victory is yours. Walk into your day with confidence. Walk into your week with authority. Walk into your season with expectation. Your morning is secured. Your day is blessed. Your future is bright. Don't let the sun rise without praying. Psalm 5. Don't let the day begin without engaging heaven. Don't let the enemy have the first word. Your voice shall be heard in the morning. Your prayer shall be directed unto God. Your expectation shall be met with manifestation. I decree over you. Favor is your portion. Protection is your covering. Breakthrough is your testimony. Victory is your reality. This week you shall laugh. This month you shall celebrate. This year you shall testify. The Lord has heard your prayer. The Lord has seen your tears. The Lord is answering. Robocai shondor rabbi keia shaba it is sealed it is done it is finished in the mighty name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth amen and amen hallelujah now share this message send it to someone who needs to hear it be a channel of blessing and remember don't let the sun rise without praying
